verdict: Organic signals declining across all brands; no paid channels are active.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, all activity this period came from organic sources — no paid advertising ran on Meta or Google Ads for any entity. Google Business Profile delivered a combined 370 actions (direction requests, website clicks, and calls) across all brands over the last 28 days, but engagement dropped sharply in the final week, with GBP actions falling as much as 85% week-over-week at Forte and 48% at O'Hare. Search visibility is eroding at the same time, with organic search clicks down 54–75% week-over-week across entities and the last three days of the period showing near-zero activity on all profiles. Web and SEO root cause work is underway with site reindexing targeted for completion by end of October, which is expected to stabilize and then recover impressions across all three brands.

watch_item.issue: Organic search visibility and GBP engagement declined sharply in the last 7 days across all three brands, with near-zero activity recorded on Sep 14–16 — coinciding with no paid channels providing any backstop.
watch_item.fix: Web and SEO root cause fixes are in motion, with all three sites targeted for reindexing by end of October; outreach sequences and contact pulls are also being completed to support pipeline activity in the interim.
